scope: Document and sampled-data audit; recommendations only; no code, source, paid, global or external mutation
verdict: Infrastructure foundation is useful; next wave must prove real artifacts and learning before expanding source/profile coverage.

findings.title: Written benchmark does not assess artifact quality
findings.correction: Keep written decision coverage and add rendered baseline/enriched artifacts with separate technical and creative reviews.

findings.title: Sampled deliverable contracts contain semantic mismatches
findings.correction: Explicitly map canonical task, competency, artifact and criterion; reject positional mapping and principle-as-deliverable extraction.
findings.scopeLimit: Sample proves specific problems only; no claim all 512 contracts are incorrect.

findings.title: Priorities do not express observed return or capacity
findings.correction: Use one priority semantic, rank actual deliverable families and bound WIP to three active families.

findings.title: Acquisition acceptance emphasizes source count without marginal gain
findings.correction: Acquire per observed failure; record independence, transfer conditions and measured benefit, retaining source/rights gates.

findings.title: Human review has no operational learning loop
findings.correction: Capture feedback, rejected artifact, cause, rule candidate, exception and reserved transfer case; separate personal/client preferences from general methods.

findings.title: Jev lacks an explicit extraction-only default
findings.correction: Default to extraction once per source/version with persistent cache. Per-output judgment stays a separate benefit-tested experiment.
findings.scopeLimit: Design gap only; no paid misuse observed and prior content-specific preference is not treated as a universal prohibition.

findings.title: Cost and freshness policy lacks per-competency operational criteria
findings.correction: Track total known/unknown artifact cost and time to approval; revalidate only changed/failed competence with bounded acquisition budgets.

findings.title: Corpus and profile effects are not isolated
findings.correction: Keep model fixed and compare baseline, retrieved KB, and KB plus profile; model and Jev experiments have separate cohorts.

alternatives.name: Expand all172 acquisition
alternatives.tradeoff: Faster inventory coverage; uncertain effect on perceived output quality.

alternatives.name: Deliverable-family evolution
alternatives.tradeoff: Three artifact families yield observable quality/rework evidence; remaining profiles stay planned until transfer is validated.

alternatives.name: Full taxonomy repair first
alternatives.tradeoff: Structural consistency improves but delays actual deliverable proof; prefer narrow repairs tied to the three families.

recommendedDag.name: Value and baseline
recommendedDag.route: product-orqx with product specialists and creative owners
actions: Freeze three authorized briefs, one per family
Rank observed frequency/rework/impact/confidence/effort with unknowns explicit
Record baseline artifact time/cost/rework
acceptance: Metric unit is approved artifact per user/brief

recommendedDag.name: Contracts and rubric
actions: Review explicit canonical mappings
Freeze technical gates and anchored creative rubric
acceptance: Critical gates and weights frozen before generation

recommendedDag.name: Six rendered comparison artifacts
actions: Produce three baseline/enriched pairs with same model/assets/brief
Render UI plus motion, encoded Reel, and final-size carousel in isolated fixtures
acceptance: Desktop and390px UI captures without horizontal overflow

recommendedDag.name: Independent review and user learning
recommendedDag.conditionalBlock: Final user preference/approval awaits Caio feedback on concrete pairs
actions: Randomize pair order
Separate technical, creative and user judgments
Capture cause/rule/exception/new-case for each rejection
acceptance: Proposed creative target90/100 with every dimension at least15/20
Scores anchored per family before comparison

recommendedDag.name: Failure-driven acquisition
recommendedDag.conditionalBlock: Private source requires lawful access and rights; no purchase/login inferred
actions: Acquire only mechanisms addressing observed pilot failures
Capture source locator hash conditions exceptions and transfer context
acceptance: Every unit traces to a pilot failure or genuinely new applicable mechanism
Suspend family after two batches without new applicable mechanism or reduced observed error

recommendedDag.name: Persistent extraction and reserved transfer
recommendedDag.route: cloning-orqx with delivery and independent evaluation specialists
actions: Persist extraction per source/version
Prepare optional Jev pilot
Evaluate three unseen briefs per family, two repetitions per variant with fixed model
acceptance: Identical source/version cache prevents repeat paid extraction
36 reserved outputs is pilot ceiling, not universal quota
Report score distribution preference critical failures cost and rework
Any critical failure blocks affected competence promotion
No causal/statistical claim without separate analysis

recommendedDag.name: Competence promotion and fixture delivery
recommendedDag.conditionalBlock: Personal HOME installation, other projects and publication retain current authority gates
actions: Promote only assessed competence with evidence/version/limits
Verify fixture installation update and rollback
Open next family only after close/suspend
acceptance: WIP remains at most three active families

recommendedDag.name: Optional live Jev
recommendedDag.blocker: Service key absent in currently verified environment
actions: Use secure credential flow and existing authorized shared ledger
acceptance: Typed response schema and disagreement reported

recommendedDag.name: Optional candidate model cohort
recommendedDag.route: runtime owner and independent creative reviewer
recommendedDag.blocker: Authenticated candidate runtime access not observed
actions: Run same reserved task cohort only after real account availability and applicable cost authority
acceptance: Quality cost latency and regressions compared

memoryUse.purpose: Prior content-specific extraction-only preference; historical model/pricing values not used as current facts

limitations: No tests from prior checkpoint were rerun by this audit
No real artifact quality or user approval is proven
No external sources were newly read
No actual ROI or monetary cost invented
Root coordinates narrow specialist review before executing corrected phases
